text:
acelyn-sales: Heads-up — Thalassia (prospect) wants to validate onboarding a cust-mistral-14B variant into Dedicated for a 30-day POC. Primary asks: tokenizer parity, emb extraction for search pipeline, KMS + HSM controls, and whether our KV-cache layout supports their chunked context (4096 window with rolling chunks). Can eng/ML confirm?

ryan-ml: quick flags: if tokenizer differs we can map via mergemap or provide a tokenizer adapter. We need their tokenizer.json + vocab to confirm token ID offsets (esp for special tokens). Embedding extraction: do they want off-the-shelf CLS vectors or pooler variants?

acelyn-sales: they asked for CLS-like sentence embeddings to feed their vector DB (we'll pipeline into Pinecone-like). Also asked if embeddings generation can be run at lower precision to save cost.

marco-eng: embeddings can be served via a separate route with mixed precision (fp16) safely. For the main generator, q8_0 or q4_k_m are our recommended quant profiles for 14B on the A100s. Rolling 4096 window: our KV layout supports segmented caching but need to confirm chunk alignment. If they use rolling overlap windows we should validate with a small sim.

ivy-sre: security: Thalassia requires customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed CMKs and a requirement that we never persist plaintext model keys. Private/Dedicated supports KMS passthrough; for Dedicated we usually store wrapped keys and keep audit logs. Need legal to confirm export control on model bits.

nina-legal: noted. I'll ask for a brief model provenance statement from the customer and prepare a KMS/HSM assurance blurb. Also check if model license has export restrictions.

harper-ps: enterprise blocker: they want an SLA on p99 latency for embedding calls (<120ms) and generation (<200ms at seq=512). Can we commit for a POC?

marco-eng: POC commitment: we can do best-effort on standard Dedicated; SLA requires reserved capacity sizing. For a 30-day POC we can offer a provisional perf target if they take a small reserved pool (2 GPUs) — will need load profiles.

acelyn-sales: they also want a short compatibility test before handing over the full checkpoint. Is a metadata dump enough?

ryan-ml: minimal artifacts: tokenizer.json + merges + model config + a single param shard (first shard ok) or stateless weight snapshot. With that we can run tokenization equivalence test, param shape check, and a small forward pass smoke. For perf/permutation we need full weights.

acelyn-sales: perfect. Can infra provide a one-line extract command the customer can run locally?

infra-bot: Command suggestion:

```
python -m redwood.tools.inspect_model --ckpt /path/to/shard.pt --out meta.txt
# outputs: tokenizer_hash, param_shapes.txt, rmsnorm:True/False, dtype:fp32/float16
```

marco-eng: I'll add a small script wrapper to parse meta.txt into a compat_report.json we can ingest.

ryan-ml: note on tokenizer adapters: if special tokens shift ids we can remap during conversion but must update KV cache indexing. Small risk there; we'll flag in report.

ivy-sre: network & compliance: for Dedicated we need their IP allowlist and egress rules. If they want on-prem-like isolation, we can do VPC peering + restricted egress. Share our POC network checklist (I'll paste link).

ivy-sre: POC checklist: https://internal.redwood/sops/pocs/dedicated-checklist (contains VPC config, audit log retention, and KMS flow).

harper-ps: pricing ask: AE wanted uplift estimate for Dedicated POC with 2x A100 reserved for 1 month. Any ballpark?

marco-eng: ballpark: infra reservation +20%-35% on top of usage for placement + ops onboarding fee. I'll confirm with finance for exact quote.

nina-legal: I'll prepare a short template confirming wrapped-key storage and KMS passthrough controls. Also request their model provenance doc and a signed attestation if the model references any flagged datasets.

acelyn-sales: action items: (1) I'll ask Thalassia for tokenizer.json + merges + model config + sample shard; (2) @ryan-ml run tokenization/shape smoke on receipt; (3) @marco-eng produce provisional perf estimate & draft infra uplift; (4) @nina-legal produce KMS/HSM assurance blurb; (5) @ivy-sre share network checklist link (done).

infra-bot: Ticket created: D-PROC-9021 (owner: marco-eng) — attach compat_report.json when ready.

acelyn-sales: thanks all, I'll ping once customer sends the artifacts. :rocket:
